_comment: Expectations after schema_migrations_input_ddl.json — exercises AddColumn / AlterColumn / ChangeColumnType against tester_transaction and tester_composite_table.

assertions.name: tester_transaction exists
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: tester_composite_table exists
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_composite_table') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: tester_transaction has the AddColumn DDL-added column
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction' AND columnname = 'col_added') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: no orphan _alter_tmp tables remain after DDL migrations
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM dbc.tablesv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename IN ('tester_transaction_alter_tmp','tester_composite_table_alter_tmp')
